name: devconnect-backend
description: Backend API for DevConnect Professional Networking Platform

scripts.build: npx prisma@6 generate && npx prisma@6 migrate deploy
scripts.test:api: cross-env NODE_ENV=test vitest run tests/api --config tests/vitest.config.js
scripts.test:auth: cross-env NODE_ENV=test vitest run tests/api/auth --config tests/vitest.config.js
scripts.test:profile: cross-env NODE_ENV=test vitest run tests/api/profile --config tests/vitest.config.js
scripts.test:posts: cross-env NODE_ENV=test vitest run tests/api/posts --config tests/vitest.config.js
scripts.test:users: cross-env NODE_ENV=test vitest run tests/api/users --config tests/vitest.config.js
scripts.test:notifications: cross-env NODE_ENV=test vitest run tests/api/notifications --config tests/vitest.config.js
